usedFor: Duply makes marketing images and videos, and HubSpot logs the work as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Created” in Duply, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each finished video is a deliverable worth tracking, so a deal opens for it in HubSpot.

watchOut: “New Video Created” in Duply is polling, so a deal appears after a scheduled check, not at once.
